chunks: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you commits an act of clear shamelessness, her punishment will be doubled. And that is easy for Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific punishment for the wives of the Prophet if they commit a clear sin?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Ahzab underscores the elevated spiritual status of the Prophet's wives (Ahl al-Bayt), establishing that their proximity to the Prophet necessitates greater accountability for their actions. In Shia scholarship, this doubling of punishment is often interpreted as a sign of their high rank, where even minor sins carry heavier weight due to their exemplary role for the community. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the unique position of the Ummahat al-Mu'minin within the broader framework of Islamic jurisprudence and theology.
